notes.title: S.S.C. Rusted Demo Now Available
notes.content:
[b]S.S.C. Rusted now has a free, playable DEMO![/b]

This demo includes several combat sections, portions of the story, access to various minigames/side quests, and the ability to obtain costumes!

If anyone is unsure about checking out S.S.C. Rusted, this demo provides a substantial slice of the game for players to experience.

NOTE: Progress does not transfer over to the main game.
You can save your [i]demo's[/i] progress, but in order to load it upon restarting the demo, the player will need to manually reenter the save room and select 'LOAD'. [i](Do not use the main menu).[/i]

Adventure awaits! Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Accessibility Update
notes.content:
S.S.C. Rusted can now be toggled to 'Easy Mode' at any time through the settings page on the main menu. This mode dramatically slows down enemy attacks. It does not apply to minigames, quests, or post-game content. Steam achievements can still be obtained with this mode enabled.

Combat backgrounds can now be dimmed through the settings page on the main menu. This is useful for players who struggle to see or focus on reticles, or who are bothered by the flashing colors and designs often present in combat backgrounds. Steam achievements can still be obtained with this mode enabled.

Players can now sprint by holding the SHIFT key. If using WASD keys, hold RIGHT SHIFT. If using arrow keys, hold LEFT SHIFT.

Miscellaneous other changes also implemented.
